domain_hint: CFD of a 300 mm 90-degree HVAC elbow with turning vanes to predict pressure drop and outlet uniformity
ambiguity_notes:
- Intended use vs sign-off: slides say “not for certification” but also that results will be used to release hardware.
- Model choice: baseline claims SST; elsewhere a plan and sensitivity cite realizable k–ε and different near-wall treatment.
- Grid/time adequacy: strong claims of residuals <1e-5 and three-grid convergence; elsewhere note stalled residuals at 3e-3 and two-grid extrapolation at 12 m/s.
- Boundary/input pedigree: inlet said to use measured profile; 12 m/s runs used uniform inlet with 10% TI; fluid properties at 20°C vs tests at ~25°C.
- Comparison to tests: kickoff summary stated “within 5% across speeds” but 12 m/s shows +13.5% deviation.
- Reproducibility/config control: most runs under Git tag; one “hotfix” run off-repo and single precision due to resource limits.
